resolution: The regress result WITTGENSTEIN-INTERPRETATION-REGRESS is neutral between the readings: it derives STMT-NO-RULE-APPLICATION-DETERMINED from STMT-RULE-DETERMINED-ONLY-THROUGH-INTERPRETATION and STMT-NO-ENDLESS-INTERPRETATION-REGRESS, and the fork theorem shows these two are inconsistent with STMT-SOME-RULE-APPLICATION-DETERMINED. The diagnostic reading (following PU §201's own next sentence, STMT-PU-SOME-GRASP-OF-RULE-NOT-INTERPRETATION) keeps determination and rejects the interpretation premise. Kripke's sceptic (STMT-KRIPKE-NO-FACT-OF-MEANING, as reported) denies that any fact determines meaning; this vocabulary maps that, unattributed, to giving up STMT-SOME-RULE-APPLICATION-DETERMINED for factual determination, and it does not record whether the figure keeps the interpretation premise. Neither reading is attributed to the text by the result.
